text:
clare: Quick sync: finalizing the battlecard for the 'Serving First' webinar. Goal: one-page executive claim + two slide rebut bullets + routing rules for signups. Keep vendor names generic (legal asked).
omar: Re hero claim: let's angle on 'operational predictability' not just raw perf. Suggested: 'Predictable inference — lower tail latency, predictable bills, enterprise controls.'
deepa: For the benchmark callout, keep it conservative and verifiable. Proposed copy: 'On a simulated 1k concurrent tail workload, Redwood sustained 95th percentile latency 4-6x lower than a typical managed endpoint and lowered per-token compute by ~2x with caching+batching. See appendix.' Add exact infra footnote.
clare: Good. Omar/deepa can you agree on exact phrasing for slide (short) + appendix note (long)? We need it by Thursday EOD.
tony: Demo plan: 60s cold-start vs managed endpoint, then flip to Redwood hosted to show stable p95, then enable Dedicated routing to show scale. Keep toggles obvious. Also record network timeline in the demo.
omar: Routing rules for inbound leads: proposal: if 'company_size' >= 500 or 'deal_stage_intent' == 'pilot' -> route to AE; if 'security_concern' true -> route to SE; else -> nurture SDR. Also flag any 'on-prem' interest to infra-sales.
routing-bot: candidate-rule:
```
if form.company_size >= 500 or form.intent in ['pilot','po']:
  route -> ae_inbox
elif form.security_concern == true or form.on_prem_interest == true:
  route -> solutions_eng
else:
  route -> sdr_nurture
```
deepa: Follow-up emails: AE path should get 'book a 1:1 workshop' CTA and a checklist link for Private deployments. SDR path gets 2-week nurture with benchmark highlights + invite to next workshop.
clare: Rebut bullets (short): 1) 'Why not cloud endpoints?' -> unpredictable tail & limited rollout controls. 2) 'Why not DIY self-host?' -> heavy ops and missing rollout/observability. Keep each <18 words.
omar: Also add a 'cost transparency' line for field scripts: 'We show per-route token economics and routing levers to hit latency and cost targets.'
tony: Ops note: need staging demo keys and a scheduled smoke test Mon AM. ops-bot, can you confirm?
ops-bot: confirmed. staging keys created for webinar-demo user. smoke test scheduled Mon 09:30 PT. Logs will be uploaded to /shared/webinar/logs.
clare: Legal-safe phrasing approved: use 'managed endpoints' or 'cloud-managed inference' in main bullets; competitor names only in appendix with citations.
deepa: I'll draft the appendix competitive matrix with sources and link checks. Will call out assumptions (model, seq len, quant).
omar: Who will own the one-pager? I can assemble deck + landing copy. Clare will own routing snippet and CTAs. Tony will own demo script. Deepa will own benchmark writeup and appendix.
clare: Deadline: drafts by Thursday EOD, dry-run Friday 11am. Finalize routing rules with product/ops before dry-run. Thanks. :rocket:
